## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `empirical-bayes-signal-shrinkage`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-13T17:49:39.249Z.

Planning pass 2026-07-13 (directed maintainer pass, continuation): Algorithm (21) hierarchical empirical-Bayes shrinkage — calibrated uncertainty on every scorer estimate. Purpose: every signal the catalog consumes is an ESTIMATE from finite evidence — author affinity from 3 interactions, co-change confidence (12) from 2 co-closures, estimate-accuracy priors from one project's worth of closes. At the small pole (a few items, minutes old) raw maximum-likelihood estimates are noise; and small-sample estimation is a PERMANENT condition, not a cold-start phase, because at the million-item pole the subpopulations that matter (a new author, a new package dir, a fresh era from (20), a new item type) are always small even when the corpus is huge. The catalog handles WEIGHT cold-start ((5) RRF, (3)->(19) fallback hierarchy) but nothing calibrates the per-signal estimates underneath the weights. Cognitive analog: schema/prototype-based inference — when episodic evidence is thin, recall falls back on category-level expectations and blends smoothly toward instance evidence as it accumulates. Mechanism: give every counted/averaged fold statistic a conjugate hierarchical prior along its natural taxonomy — item <- type <- workspace <- shipped global defaults (Beta-Binomial for rates: co-change confidence, reopen probability, retrieval-confirmation rate; Gamma/log-normal for durations: time-to-close vs estimate; Dirichlet for categorical mixes: close_reason classes). Posterior mean is the closed-form precision-weighted blend estimate = (n*xbar + k*prior)/(n + k) — O(1) at fold time, no fitting loop; the pseudo-count k ships as a default per signal family and can graduate per-workspace through (3)'s existing label machinery. Every estimate carries a credible width, and the width is CONSUMED: packing (4)/(9) gets risk-adjusted marginal value (value = mean - lambda*sigma, lambda selectable per profile (19), so an uncertain high-scorer can enter at reduced projection instead of full verbatim); contradiction gating (14) routes wide-interval precedents to verify sooner; anytime certificates (18) widen their fusion bounds honestly under estimate uncertainty; --explain-ranking discloses the evidence basis ("affinity 0.62 — n=2, shrunk from raw 0.95 toward type prior 0.40") so agents see why thin evidence is not trusted at face value. Spectrum behavior: a minutes-old three-item workspace sits entirely at its priors — scorer output equals the shipped default ordering, stable and ceremony-free, serving pm-z436's small-end story with NO special code path; at decades/millions, n dominates and shrinkage vanishes asymptotically, while new subpopulations still get calibrated starts forever. Cost: one evidence count + one prior pointer per folded statistic, compatible with (8) — sketch-estimated counts supply n-hat and shrinkage applies on read. Distinct from (5) (rank fusion sidesteps CROSS-signal scale calibration when combining; this calibrates each estimate WITHIN its own scale before any combining), from (3)/(19) (weights over signals; this is the estimates under the weights), from (8) (approximation error injected by sketching at large N; this is sampling error at small n — the opposite pole), and from (18)'s certificate (compute-budget honesty; this is evidence honesty). Ownership: shrinkage forms + (n, prior) fold state = pm-3hps (wave 3); prior-taxonomy defaults extend the shipped scorer-contract defaults (pm-h3no pattern — extension, not reopen); risk-adjusted packing hook = pm-55ra; per-workspace k graduation = pm-uwfs/pm-atfm (wave 4).

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
